paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Australia
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for COVID-19 vaccine-related sentiments in Australia. The x-axis, labeled "Polarity scores" ranges from -1.0 to 0.6, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Counts," displays values from 0 to approximately 130,000, with tick intervals of 10,000.  A single blue line represents the sentiment data, beginning at a count of 0 near -1.0, then increasing to a peak of approximately 80,000 at a polarity score of -0.2, before declining to around 20,000 at a polarity score of 0.2, and eventually returning to a count of 0 near 0.6.
